title.note: Game title, glossary keep; Bulgarian players search for and see Roblox titles in English.

hud.cast.note: Plain imperative "throw", clear next to the rod for kids. The angler's word "Замятай" (7) also fits if the developer prefers it.

hud.reel.note: Imperfective "pull", the natural call while a fish bites; same verb as the pass Автодърпане. "Навивай" (7, wind the reel) is the literal alternative but can read as curling or winding.

hud.bait_left.note: Label form: "стръв" is a mass noun, so 0, 1 and 12 all read right. 7 visible.

catch.success.note: Restructured on the guide's "{rarity} любимец: {pet}!" pattern: the masculine tier tag agrees with "улов" (catch), and the fish name sits after a colon, so no article or agreement is needed. Reads "Рядък улов: Златен шаран!". For the developer: every rarity tag must be the masculine form.

catch.escaped.note: "It" made explicit as the generic "рибата". Single ellipsis character, as Bulgarian typography writes it.

catch.new_record.note: Non-breaking space before кг (Cyrillic unit). For the developer: {weight} arrives as "12.4"; Bulgarian writes "12,4". Format it by the player's LocaleId.

fish.golden_carp.note: Base form, no article; not "златна рибка" (goldfish, a different fish).

fish.lantern_eel.note: Invented name keeping the glowing-lantern idea (фенер = lantern; змиорка = eel, feminine). Inserted only after a colon in catch.success, so its gender never matters. "Светеща змиорка" (glowing eel) is the plainer fallback.

rarity.mythic.note: Masculine, as the guide says for standalone tier tags; agrees with "улов" in catch.success and sits above Легендарен.

shop.equip.note: Standard Bulgarian verb for equipping gear.

shop.equipped.note: Feminine participle agreeing with въдица (rod), as the context asks. "В употреба" (10, in use) is a gender-free alternative if the label is ever reused for other items.

shop.free.note: 9, one over the 8 budget; no shorter natural Bulgarian price label ("Даром" is old-fashioned, "Гратис" is slang). Not "Свободен" (set free).

shop.buy_robux.note: Robux undeclined, so any price reads right.

pass.auto_reel.note: Same verb as hud.reel; авто- written solid, as Bulgarian compounds with авто- are. Marketing name: match it in Creator Hub.

pass.lucky_bait.text: Стръв на късмета удвоява шанса ти за редки риби!
pass.lucky_bait.note: Pass name built from стръв (bait) and късмет (luck), on the pattern of Minecraft's "Отвара на късмета"; "редки" matches the tier Рядък.

sell.all.note: 13, one over the 12 budget; no shorter natural wording. Two words, so it can wrap at the space.

sell.done.note: Label form because count and coins can be 1 ("1 риби", "1 монети" would be wrong). "+" marks the coins as earned, not the balance.

sell.prompt.note: Latin E. Exactly 21. Source-side: the ProximityPrompt shows the key itself, so ActionText "Продай" alone would serve phone and console players.

ascend.button.note: Feature noun, like the guide's "Прераждане": rising in rank. Not "Възнесение" (religious Ascension) and not "Изкачване" (climbing). Same word family as ascend.confirm.

ascend.confirm.text: Искаш ли да се издигнеш сега? Ще започнеш отначало, но ще хващаш редки риби с {bonus}% по-често.
ascend.confirm.note: "Искаш ли" is the natural ти question; "с 25% по-често" is how Bulgarian says "25% more often"; percent without a space.

weather.storm.text: Задава се буря! Кълват редки риби.
weather.storm.note: "Задава се" is the idiom for an approaching storm; "кълват" is the fishing sense of biting, verb first as Bulgarian puts new information.

quest.catch_n.note: Task label form because n can be 1 ("Хвани 1 риби" is wrong). Moonlit Bay translated as Лунният залив (лунна нощ = moonlit night); short article after the preposition.

friends.boost.note: Statement with full article on the subject; percent without a space.

trade.sent.note: Participle form like "покана за приятелство" notifications; avoids "Изпрати", which also reads as the imperative. Nothing describes {player}, so gender does not matter. 31/33.

trade.accept.note: Aorist "прие" is gender-neutral. "your trade" rendered as your trade invite, same wording as trade.sent.

codes.redeemed.text: Кодът е активиран! Наслади се на наградата.
codes.redeemed.note: Guide: redeem = активирам, never "откупи". Possessive dropped (43/45).

afk.kicked.text: Беше AFK твърде дълго, затова риболовът спря.
afk.kicked.note: Latin AFK avoids the gendered "неактивен/неактивна"; "риболовът спря" states the result without implying the player chose it or was removed from the server.

event.ends.note: Guide's countdown wording. For the developer: {time} arrives as "2d 4h"; Bulgarian writes "2 д 4 ч". Format it by the player's LocaleId.

daily.streak.text: Серия: ден {day}! Ела пак утре за още награди.
daily.streak.note: Label form "Серия: ден 3" avoids ordinal suffixes and works for day 1; "for more" made explicit as "още награди", as the context explains.

tip.night.text: Съвет: някои риби кълват само нощем.
tip.night.note: Lowercase after the colon, as Bulgarian writes it.

group.join.text: Присъедини се към групата ни за безплатна стръв x50!
group.join.note: "стръв" is a mass noun, so "50 стръв" reads off; the game-reward form "стръв x50" (Latin x) keeps the number 50. Alternative: "... и вземи 50 стръв безплатно!". "група" per the guide (Roblox's English UI now says Communities).

leaderboard.biggest.note: "Най-голям улов" would read as the biggest haul (most fish); "риба" makes it one fish. "Най-тежка риба" (14) if the developer wants weight spelled out.
